title: Hosting-Bundle Domain Values and Multi-Domain Renewal Scale (Domain Registrations)

# Hosting-Bundle Domain Values and Multi-Domain Renewal Scale — Domain Registrations

Pricing desk schedule note covering two product figures of Domain Registrations: the free first-year domain that a hosting plan may bundle, and the scale applied to one manual renewal order that renews several distinct domains of the same customer.

## Free domain with a hosting plan

| TLD product | May be the free first-year domain of a hosting plan | Registration years covered free | Value of the free registration deducted from a hosting money-back refund when the customer keeps the domain |
|---|---|---|---|
| .us Domain Registration | Yes | 1 | USD 12.98 |
| .ca Domain Registration | No | 1 | USD 15.98 |
| .com Domain Registration | Yes | 1 | USD 17.98 |
| .org Domain Registration | Yes | 1 | USD 18.98 |
| .net Domain Registration | Yes | 1 | USD 19.98 |
| .co Domain Registration | No | 1 | USD 32.98 |
| .io Domain Registration | No | 1 | USD 56.98 |

## Multi-domain renewal scale (every TLD product)

| Distinct domains of the same customer renewed in one manual renewal order | Discount on the renewal-price component of each domain line |
|---|---|
| Fewer than 5 | None |
| 5 to 19 | 3 per cent |
| 20 or more | 6 per cent |

The highest step whose minimum number of domains does not exceed the count of the order applies; the scale is the same on .us, .ca, .com, .org, .net, .co and .io Domain Registrations.

## Hypothetical illustration

A hypothetical manual renewal order renewing 4 distinct domains takes no step of the scale; one renewing 5 takes the 3 per cent step; one renewing 19 still takes 3 per cent; and one renewing 20 takes the 6 per cent step.
